lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，几乎不出声。
lines.en: I glide along, almost silent.
There are no feet under this robe.
I step in pauses, as if reciting.

lines.zh: 壳质的外皮在暗处反光。
lines.en: My shell skin catches light in the dark.
I follow the damp air for a path.
The wind in this world is too dry.
My hands hang low the whole way.
I go around the grass without touching it.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过草，草都湿了。
lines.en: My hem brushes the grass and leaves it wet.
I am in no hurry; prey moves.
Low ground is safer.
I hear breathing far away.

lines.zh: 光落在我脸上，我低下头。
lines.en: Light falls on my face; I lower it.
The shell on my shoulder clicks softly.
My steps keep no rhythm.
I go around the bushes without touching them.
I stand as if in prayer.
There is salt in the air.
I raise my head slowly.
My eyes haven't blinked once.
The noise here is too cluttered.
I listen without moving.
The wind lifts one corner of my robe.
My palms are wet.
Something breathes far off.
I wait for it to come near.
I bow my head and close my fingers.
I hold this posture a long while.
This body needs no rest.
Only in silence can I hear.
Your breathing has gone unsteady.

lines.zh: 你的脉搏跳得太急，藏不住。
lines.en: Your pulse races too fast to hide.
I learned to breathe on land.

lines.zh: 你摸向腰间，我先举起手。
lines.en: You reach for your belt; I raise my hand first.
I watch you without blinking.
You carry no scent of the sea.
My prayer is a sniper's shot.

lines.zh: 你身上没有海的气味，奇怪。
lines.en: You carry no scent of the sea — strange.
I lift my chin to look at you.
And you look back at me.

lines.zh: 海嗣的壳，裂了一道白纹。
lines.en: A white crack runs through my seaborn shell.

lines.zh: 壳上裂开一道白纹，没有血。
lines.en: A white crack opens on my shell, but no blood.
No blood; only water.
I press the wound.
It hurts, and I make no sound.
You hit me.

lines.zh: 破口处滴下来的水是咸的。
lines.en: The water dripping from the tear is salt.
I raise my hand again.
This body is tougher than it looks.

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，一声也没出。
lines.en: I press the wound and make no sound at all.

lines.zh: 陆上的食物，我可咽不下。
lines.en: Land food won't go down.
That smell unsettles me.

lines.zh: 陆上的食物，我咽不下去。
lines.en: Food from dry land won't go down.
My food is in the sea.
Why are you still holding it?
My stomach stirs for none of it.
The smell is too strong; stand back.

lines.zh: 这个味道让我后退了半步。
lines.en: That smell makes me step back half a pace.
I will not stop for that.
It only makes me quicker.
You bumped into my robe.
I give half a step without a sound.
Do not touch my shell.
This body is very light.
You came at the wrong angle.
I turn slightly aside.
You have scuffed my wet trail.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的湿痕里，退出去。
lines.en: You've stepped into my wet trail — back out.
I raise a hand between us.
That is better.

lines.zh: 我的族类只随潮水行动。
lines.en: My kind move only with the tide.
My kind do not do such things.
We obey only the tide.
You asked the wrong one.
I have other work.
Do not lean so close.
There is nothing inside this body.
That subject has no meaning.
Ask me something else.
I fall silent.
I pick up what has fallen.
I pinch it between fingertip and thumb.
There is salt on it.
Whose? It does not matter.
I tuck it inside my robe.
There is more on the ground.
I lift it and look it over.
This should not be left here.

lines.zh: 这东西上面有盐，我收进袍里。
lines.en: There's salt on this — I tuck it into my robe.
Do you want it back?

lines.zh: 海嗣的视线已经绑住你。
lines.en: A seaborn gaze has you pinned.

lines.zh: 准星落在你的胸口，别动。
lines.en: My aim rests on your chest — don't move.
My hand is already lifted.

lines.zh: 海嗣的祷告，从不带慈悲。
lines.en: A seaborn's prayer carries no mercy.
Too late to pull back.
This one will reach far.
I am reading the wind.
You have stopped moving.

lines.zh: 海嗣的祷词，从我开始念。
lines.en: The seaborn prayer starts with me.

lines.zh: 我在算风，也在算你的退路。
lines.en: I'm gauging the wind, and your way out.
I keep my eyes on your shoulder.
You are drifting left.
I have followed you.
Your breathing is quickening.
My hand stays raised.
You have slipped behind a tree.
A tree will not stop me.
I wait for your head to show.
A seaborn's patience outlasts the tide.
And out you come anyway.
A lance of light leaves my hand.
I raise a hand and something bursts far off.
My strike needs no closing of distance.

lines.zh: 我抬手，远处炸开一团水汽。
lines.en: I raise my hand and steam bursts in the distance.

lines.zh: 第二束光已经算好落点。
lines.en: I've already calculated where the second beam lands.
The second is already in flight.
I pin down the direction you move.
Your armor takes one hit.
I fall back half a step and fire again.
Running away does not make you safe.
I condense out of the damp.
The robe's hem settles first.
There is no sea here.

lines.zh: 水汽凝成我的形状，我落地。
lines.en: The vapor takes my shape and I touch down.

lines.zh: 我这身海嗣的鳞，还湿着。
lines.en: These seaborn scales are still wet.
My shell is still dripping.
I settle and look around.
Living things are in the air.

lines.zh: 这里的风太干，我的壳发紧。
lines.en: The air here is so dry my shell feels tight.
Then let it start here.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到袍角，我把它按熄。
lines.en: Fire catches my hem; I smother it.
I fall with the robe hitting first.

lines.zh: 水把我裹住，这反倒熟悉。
lines.en: Water wraps around me; this I know.
The blast scatters the damp air.

lines.zh: 东西穿过我的壳，扎在里面。
lines.en: Something splits my shell and lodges there.

lines.zh: 法术把我的祷词打断了。
lines.en: The spell cuts my prayer short.

lines.zh: 我很久没有从海里取食了。
lines.en: I have not fed from the sea in ages.
Lightning burns down along my shell.
The whole floor disappears.
